spanish: Ofrenda de principio las acercarán a Jehová, y al altar no subirán a olor de reposo.

findings.issue: Hiphil 2mp and qal 3mp both appear as Spanish -án, so the addressees who bring the offerings near can be read as the ones who do not ascend.

notes: Ofrenda de principio, las, Jehová, altar, and olor de reposo match the tokens; person switch is not marked.
